entries.sense_en: partly covered or softened, as if by a thin cloth
entries.sense_ko: 얇은 막이 덮인 듯 흐릿하게 가려진

synonyms.nuance: Suggests something dimming or darkening, often with worry or gloom rather than softness.
Hides completely and on purpose; a veil only softens.
Formal; makes something hard to see or understand, without the gentle image.

entries.sense_en: a thin, light mist in the air that makes the sky look soft

synonyms.nuance: Made of water droplets; thicker and wetter than haze.
Much denser than haze; makes it hard to see far.
Polluted haze over a city; not a pleasant, natural one.

entries.sense_en: a very high-ranking angel; here, a grand heavenly visitor

synonyms.nuance: General word for a heavenly messenger; an archangel ranks above ordinary angels.
Literary; the highest order of angels, often shown burning with light.

entries.tip_ko: archangel의 arch-는 [ɑrk]로 발음합니다. archbishop의 arch-[ɑrtʃ]와 다릅니다.

entries.sense_en: a very large open-sided tent for outdoor parties (British use)

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word, usually for camping or shelter; a marquee is bigger and made for parties.
Can be a light building or big tent for events; more formal and more permanent.
A cover held up over something; usually smaller and not fully enclosed.

entries.tip_ko: 미국에서는 극장 입구 위의 간판 차양을 뜻하기도 합니다.

entries.sense_en: a towel or cloth wound round the head, here to cover wet hair

synonyms.nuance: A square cloth tied over the hair; lighter and simpler than a wound turban.
Modern general word for any cloth wrapped round the head.

entries.sense_en: watch workers and direct what they do

synonyms.nuance: Similar, but more about responsibility for the whole job than watching people closely.
Includes making decisions, planning and organizing, not only watching.
Just watches and checks progress; does not necessarily give orders.

entries.sense_en: strict and serious in expression, showing no friendliness

synonyms.nuance: Serious and firm, often with authority; a bit warmer than severe.
About following rules, not about the look on someone's face.
Sad, hard or threatening; suggests bad news more than authority.

entries.tip_ko: severe는 표정뿐 아니라 severe pain(극심한 통증)처럼 정도가 심할 때도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: fake and put on to impress; not natural

synonyms.nuance: Made or done unnaturally; can describe things, not only manner.
Stronger and more critical: trying to seem more important or cultured than one is.
Neutral; just not normal, without the idea of showing off.

entries.tip_ko: '영향을 받은'이라는 흔한 뜻과 다른 뜻입니다. 문맥으로 구별하세요.

entries.sense_en: spoke with pauses and repeated sounds because of nervousness

synonyms.nuance: Nearly the same; the usual American word, especially for a lasting speech condition.
Voice or steps weaken and hesitate; less about repeated sounds.
Speaking too quietly and unclearly, not repeating sounds.

entries.sense_en: tall and thin, with long arms and legs

synonyms.nuance: Tall, thin and awkward in movement; often used for teenagers.
Positive: thin in an attractive way; lanky is about height and awkwardness.
Informal and often negative: too thin, without stressing height.

entries.sense_en: easy to see; standing out

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; can be seen or felt, but not necessarily striking.
Stands out because of position or importance, often in a good way.
Easy to understand or see; more about clarity than standing out.

entries.tip_ko: conspicuous는 눈에 띄는 것이 어색하거나 과할 때도 씁니다 (conspicuous absence).

entries.sense_en: right in front of you, impossible to miss (workman's slang)
entries.sense_ko: 눈앞에 딱 보이는, 놓칠 수 없게

synonyms.word: right in front of one's eyes
synonyms.nuance: Plain modern phrase for the same idea, without the slang.
synonyms.example: It was right in front of my eyes.

synonyms.nuance: Modern informal phrase about exact position, not visibility.
synonyms.example: smack in the middle of the lawn

entries.modern: "a bang slap in the eye" → "right where everyone can see it"

entries.sense_en: looking tired, thin and worried

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; only says sleepy or worn out, without the thin, worried look.
Face looks thin and tense from illness or worry; less extreme.
Very thin, bony and often ill-looking, stronger than haggard.

entries.sense_en: a small piece of a plant with a few leaves

synonyms.nuance: A thin woody branch of a tree, usually without the idea of leaves being picked.
The main stalk of a plant; a sprig is a small cut piece with leaves.
New growth from a plant, not a piece that has been pinched off.

entries.sense_en: breathed in sharply through the nose to smell something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a short breath in through the nose; snuff is older and stronger.
Breathe in generally, through nose or mouth, not focused on smelling.
Most general word; can be passive, with no active breathing in.

entries.tip_ko: snuff out a candle(촛불을 끄다)의 snuff와 뜻이 다릅니다.

entries.sense_en: felt strong contempt for; thought worthless

synonyms.nuance: Open, mocking contempt; often shown in words or behavior.
Strong dislike or anger; despise adds the idea that the thing is beneath you.
Informal phrase; feel superior to someone, milder than despise.

entries.sense_en: a quick look (Australian and New Zealand slang)

synonyms.nuance: Standard word for a very quick look; less casual than squiz.
A quick, often secret look, as at something hidden.
General word; no idea of speed or informality.

entries.sense_en: shining brightly, full of light and colour

synonyms.nuance: Common word for strong light or colour, less glowing and less poetic.
So bright it almost hurts the eyes; more intense than radiant.
Soft, steady light or warm colour, gentler than radiant.

entries.tip_ko: 사람에게 쓰면 '행복으로 빛나는'이라는 뜻이 됩니다 (a radiant smile).

entries.sense_en: deep, rich red

synonyms.nuance: Bright red with a little orange; livelier than crimson.
Plain colour word; crimson is deeper, richer, more literary.
Dark brownish red, duller than crimson.

entries.sense_en: bent low with knees bent, close to the ground

synonyms.nuance: Sit low on the heels; crouch may lean forward, often from fear or to hide.
Bend the upper body forward and down while standing.
Rest on one or both knees on the ground.

entries.sense_en: make an angry or upset person calm

synonyms.nuance: Most general; works for people, animals or situations.
Comfort gently, often pain or worry, with a soft voice or touch.
Formal; stop someone's anger by giving them something or giving in.

entries.sense_en: extremely beautiful or delicate and finely made

synonyms.nuance: Fine and light, easily broken; does not mean top quality on its own.
Graceful and stylish; about style more than fine craftsmanship.
Everyday, warm word; much weaker and less refined than exquisite.

entries.tip_ko: 미국에서는 주로 두 번째 음절에 강세를 두고(ex-QUIS-ite), 첫 음절 강세(EX-quis-ite)도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: full of great joy and excitement (here partly put on)

synonyms.nuance: Wild happiness, often loud; both are very strong.
Eager and keen; much milder than rapturous.
Very pleased; ordinary, polite word, not overflowing.

entries.sense_en: strong enjoyment, here of telling bad news

synonyms.nuance: Neutral and general; does not suggest a slightly shameful pleasure.
Lively, energetic enthusiasm, mostly for food or action.
Energetic excitement about life or an activity, always positive.

entries.sense_en: going too far; exaggerated and unreasonable

synonyms.nuance: More than is needed or acceptable; neutral and formal.
Made to seem bigger than it is; about description more than behaviour.
Spending or using too much; usually about money or resources.

entries.tip_ko: 돈을 헤프게 쓴다는 뜻으로 주로 알려져 있지만, 여기서는 '엉뚱하게 지나치다'는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: something ugly that spoils the view

synonyms.nuance: A mark that spoils the appearance of a place; more figurative.
Something that spoils an area over time, often by neglect.
Informal: 'What a sight!' says something looks messy or ridiculous.

entries.sense_en: dirty, poor and morally low

synonyms.nuance: Dirty and miserable, especially about living conditions; more physical than sordid.
Shabby and slightly disreputable, milder than sordid.
Worn out and poorly kept; nothing morally bad.

entries.sense_en: moved about in large, crowded numbers

synonyms.nuance: Be full of moving living things; more literary, usually with 'with'.
People gather closely; not the buzzing, insect-like image of swarm.
A large crowd moving together; literary.

entries.sense_en: a walk around quietly and curiously, looking for something

synonyms.nuance: A relaxed, pleasant walk; a prowl is secret or restless.
Walk without a goal; a prowl has some purpose, like searching.
Travel freely over a wide area; less stealthy.

entries.sense_en: needing a lot of effort and energy

synonyms.nuance: Makes you very tired; focuses on the result, not the effort.
Asks a lot of skill, time or attention, not only physical effort.
Everyday and milder; makes you feel tired.

entries.sense_en: showing too much soft emotion instead of thinking practically

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; shows feelings strongly, not necessarily too much.
Informal British; silly and over-romantic, more mocking.
Positive: gently loving and caring.

entries.tip_ko: 우리말 '센티멘탈'처럼 좋은 뜻만 있는 것이 아니라, 비판할 때도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: small, cramped and unpleasant to live in

synonyms.nuance: Too little space for what is inside; neutral description.
Very small, and could be cute; no idea of being unpleasant.
Small but warm and comfortable, the opposite feeling to poky.

entries.sense_en: unclear, without sharp edges, like a memory that is fading

synonyms.nuance: Soft-edged or unclear; informal, also used for thoughts.
Not clearly stated or remembered; about ideas more than pictures.
Unclear as if seen through a mist; often for memory.

entries.sense_en: a fight or busy contest; here, the busy business of the party

synonyms.nuance: A serious, organized fight; fray is more confused and noisy.
A rough, noisy fight, usually among a few people in public.
A hurried, disorderly rush to get something.

entries.tip_ko: 'ready for the fray'는 '한바탕 치를 준비가 된'이라는 관용 표현입니다.

entries.sense_en: said in a high, musical, cheerful voice

synonyms.nuance: A short, light, bird-like sound; quicker than trill.
Sing with quick changes in pitch, like a bird.
Speak with too much excitement, often not sincere.

entries.sense_en: opened his eyes wide and stared, playfully

synonyms.nuance: Look at something for a long time; goggle stresses wide, bulging eyes.
Stare with the mouth open, from shock or wonder.
Informal and rude: stare stupidly.

entries.sense_en: excellent (old-fashioned British slang)

synonyms.nuance: Slightly formal and old-fashioned; grand and impressive.
Informal British, once popular; very good.
Common modern word for good; flat by comparison.

entries.modern: "an absolutely topping hat" → "a really great hat"

entries.sense_en: looking attractive on the person wearing it

synonyms.nuance: Makes someone look better; the everyday modern word.
Pleasant to look at in general, not specifically on the wearer.
Right for a person or occasion; not about looks.

entries.modern: "a becoming hat" → "a hat that suits you"

entries.sense_en: moved her hands about nervously, feeling uneasy

synonyms.nuance: Twist the body from embarrassment or discomfort.
Turn something round and round idly with the fingers.
Twist and turn in small quick movements, often to escape.

entries.sense_en: saying or doing things that upset people without noticing

synonyms.nuance: Doesn't notice or care about others' feelings; can be deliberate.
Formal; lacking skill in handling delicate situations.
Says the truth directly, maybe on purpose; tactless is unintended.

entries.sense_en: whatever else may be true; at least

synonyms.nuance: Common; points to a smaller good thing in a bad situation.
Informal; moves on or ignores what came before.
A bit more formal; stresses that the result is the same regardless.

entries.sense_en: dim and dark, as the light at the end of the day

synonyms.nuance: Not bright; can be any time of day.
Full of shadows; hard to see details.
Literary; lit by the last light after sunset.

entries.sense_en: upright wooden posts that make a fence

synonyms.nuance: General word for any barrier round a garden or field.
Bars or rails, often metal, along stairs or a balcony.
A pointed upright stake, as in a picket fence.

entries.sense_en: a light that shines unsteadily and goes bright and dim

synonyms.nuance: A faint, weak light that is barely there; flicker stresses going bright and dim.
Sudden, bright and very short light.
Small light that seems to sparkle, often stars; cheerful.

entries.sense_en: too smooth and falsely polite, trying to please

synonyms.nuance: Polite and fluent, and can be positive; oily is clearly insincere.
Even more disgusting: unpleasantly flattering, not to be trusted.
Formal, literary; too full of false friendliness or sympathy.

entries.sense_en: drew into small folds, as a face about to cry

synonyms.nuance: Makes lines or folds; can be from age, not only emotion.
Informal; tighten the face hard, from effort, pain or dislike.
Fall into folds; for a face, suggests collapsing into tears.

entries.sense_en: secretly knowing, as if sharing something private

synonyms.nuance: Clever at tricking others; more openly negative than sly.
Skilled at getting what you want by clever, indirect ways.
Shows you understand something secret; often not negative.

entries.sense_en: very far away, out of reach of ordinary life

synonyms.nuance: Far in space, time or feeling; the general word.
Alone and cut off from others, often with a sad feeling.
Sounds dreamy and poetic; describes places or looks.
